title: The homunculus’s work is distributed among unconscious agencies

statements.text: All the work done by the homunculus in the Cartesian theater must be distributed in space and time in the brain and outsourced to lesser agencies that are themselves unconscious and uncomprehending. The dimensionality of representations and of their consumers has to match.

sources.quote: must be distributed around in space and time in the brain, broken up and outsourced to lesser agencies that are themselves unconscious and uncomprehending
